# The Windows bundle's lean runtime set, pinned by version and sha256 so two builds of one commit ship
# the same packages. Without pins every build took that day's newest release, and an installer run over an
# older install left the older <name>-<version>.dist-info beside the new one (0.7.2 to 0.7.3: certifi,
# charset-normalizer, pydantic, pydantic-core, PyYAML, regex, bitarray).
#
# Made with: uv pip compile <the package list build_bundle.ps1 names> -c <uv.lock's name==version set>
#   --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --generate-hashes
# so every version here is the one uv.lock pins, the set CI tests. Every pin is a wheel for cp312 win_amd64
# or py3-none-any, except proxy-tools (sdist only, built with the setuptools from requirements-windows-build.txt).
# build_bundle.ps1 downloads this file into a wheelhouse with --require-hashes --no-deps, then installs its
# package list from that wheelhouse only (--no-index), so no other version can be taken.
# tests/test_windows_installer_clean_upgrade.py keeps this file, build_bundle.ps1 and uv.lock in step.
aiohappyeyeballs==2.6.2 \

    --hash=sha256:e202810ee718bd01fc6ef49e8ea53d023d5cb6b581076d7925aa499fa55dbe64
